title: OpenPackagedFood Product Metadata Document (v0.3)
description: Stored at products/gtin/{p1}/{p2}/{gtin14}/product.json or products/opf/{brand}/{product}/{spec}/product.json. Holds only product-level aliases and non-default track discriminator definitions; editions, supersedes edges, and revisions live in editions/<ulid>.json.

aliases.description: Colloquial names, search aliases, or secondary retail pack names.

tracks.description: Documentation and observable disambiguation rules for non-default tracks referenced by editions/<ulid>.json. Default tracks (<market>/default) do not require entries here.

ProductId.description: Canonical primary identifier: either gtin:<14-digit-gtin> or opf:<brand-slug>/<product-slug>/<spec-slug>.

NonDefaultTrackKey.description: Discriminated track identifier such as CN/plant:SC111, CN/plant:{SC111,SC222}, CN/code:A, or CN/origin:NZ.

field.description: JSON pointer or field path on the Edition that corresponds to this discriminator (e.g. attributes.parties[].license).

instructions.description: Human- and Agent-readable instructions explaining how to identify this track on a physical package.
